## Checklist

- [ ] No personal information (names, emails, home-folder paths) in the code, commit messages, this description or screenshots
- [ ] Nothing from my workloop data folder (`~/.workloop`): no projects, seats, handoffs, digests, notes or transcripts
- [ ] No project names, hostnames, internal URLs or other details of my work
- [ ] No tokens, keys or passwords
- [ ] Commits use a no-reply email address
